section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews literature on body image threats (dieting, fat talk, peer influence) and self-compassion as a protective factor. It discusses how self-compassion—comprising self-kindness, mindfulness, and common humanity—may buffer against negative body image consequences, particularly in the presence of body image threats such as higher BMI or sociocultural pressures. The section cites multiple prior studies (Kelly et al. 2014, Tylka et al. 2015, Homan & Tylka 2015, etc.) but does not present original empirical data or specify details about the current study's methodology.
